stem: Which sentence from the story shows that El-ahrairah is friendly?

options.text: They say that after that El-ahrairah wandered far and wide, and everywhere he went he gave the animals and birds good advice and help. He met mice and water rats and even an otter, which did him no harm; yet he seemed no nearer to what he was seeking.
At last, one day, he came to a great expanse of common land, and at last, tired out, lay down in a sunny place.
As he lay dozing, he felt the presence of some creature close by and opened his eyes, to see a snake watching him.
